name: Ubiquitin · in motion
description: A real 2 ps ubiquitin trajectory at 300 K. Amber ff14SB + GBn2 implicit solvent, 2 fs Langevin-middle steps, seed 2026. An exploration of motion, not an equilibrated scientific study.
warnings: Only 2 ps of production after 0.2 ps initial relaxation: this demonstration does not establish equilibration or convergence.
The starting model was explicitly selected from PDB 1UBQ; 58 crystallographic water atoms were excluded for implicit solvent.
No periodic box: measurements use ordinary Cartesian geometry.
Display frames are aligned on protein alpha carbons; plotted geometry uses unaligned simulation frames.
